name: Agriculture and farm records
one_line: The operator-side record of running fields, crops, livestock and farm inputs through a season: field and herd registers, cultivation and treatment logs, yields, movements, subsidy evidence and assurance inspections. It differs from the resource_operations default by requiring a biological production unit and its seasonal husbandry or traceability relation, while keeping the schema's authority, measured-output and period roles fieldless pending R1c.

node_test.why: This is a template, not a second schema. The resource_operations anchor already provides the fieldless default and its broad signals for authorised sources, operating units, measured output and reporting period. The farm situation earns a separate template only if its own-file evidence requires a field/block, crop or livestock unit, husbandry or input activity, seasonal production record, or traceability relation; those are organizational situations and values, not newly licensed fields. The recommended farm order would be site or holding → field, block or herd → crop, livestock or output stream → reporting period → record type, but it remains prose because PR-6 leaves the resource_operations schema without fields. Privacy differs in practice where farm records join named operators, land parcels, animal identifiers, veterinary medicines and subsidy or assurance status; that is a safety posture for the template, not a new handling class. If R1c finds that biological-unit detection and privacy are not materially different from the resource default, this row must be collapsed into the default rather than preserved for the legacy label.

deterministic: a field or crop-plan register with labelled holding or farm, field or block identifier, crop or variety, season or crop year, area, planned activity and input or harvest schedule; a field name or crop word without the register relation is insufficient

a livestock, herd or flock register whose rows join a holding or enterprise to animal, batch or group identifiers, species or breed, birth or acquisition, movement, treatment, breeding or sale events, and a date or status; one ear-tag-shaped token alone is not enough

a cultivation or input-application log with labelled field or block, crop, product or treatment, application date, quantity or rate, operator or machine record, withholding or safety interval, and completion or approval state

a harvest, yield or production return that joins a named field, crop or livestock group to an operating period, area or headcount, harvested or produced quantity, unit, grade or destination, and a declaration or traceability reference

a farm-to-lot traceability record linking seed, feed, fertiliser, veterinary medicine or other input batch to a field, crop, animal group, treatment date and resulting harvest, sale or withdrawal record; an invoice line or product name alone is not this relation

an operator-side subsidy or stewardship claim whose form joins the applicant's holding to eligible fields, crops, animals or land measures, claim period, declared activity and supporting maps or registers; a funder's award or assessment without farm-production evidence is government grant administration

an assurance or certification inspection packet with a farm or holding, production system, inspected fields or animal groups, evidence checklist, findings, corrective action and closeout or renewal state; an abstract audit policy or generic compliance checklist is not farm evidence

a farm water, nutrient, waste or environmental operating record that joins an authority or permit condition to a field, storage or application point, measured use or result, operating period and action; an authority's permit register without operator-side use is government material

a geospatial or structured farm export whose manifest, layers or tables identify field boundaries or blocks and join them to crop, land use, season, herd area or management activity; a generic rural map with no operating relation is not enough

an archive manifest that groups field plans, livestock registers, treatment logs, yield returns, claims and inspection evidence under one holding, season or assurance cycle; the archive is inspected through its manifest without unpacking

a calendar event or email that carries an exact holding, field, herd, treatment, inspection or delivery reference and a bounded farm workflow may join an accepted group, but the communication format alone does not activate this template

template.why: Empty because resource_operations is a PR-6 placeholder and declares no legal destination fields. Subject to R1c, the farm situation recommends holding or site → field/block or herd/flock → crop, livestock group or output stream → reporting period → record type, with an asset or lot branch only where it is actually the stable operating subject. A field-led alternative suits crop work; a herd-led alternative suits livestock records. Operating authority, measured quantities, animal identifiers, chemical rates, prices, locations and claim numbers remain evidence/search values, not authored dimensions. This is not time-first: 00 states, "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." The recommendation is editable because 00 states, "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions."

collides_with.signal: SAME FIXTURE BYTES: `Subsidy-Claim_2026_Field-12.pdf`. Direction one — resource_operations.farm-records owns the applicant-side production relation: the holding, eligible field or animal group, declared crop or stewardship activity, supporting map or register, and the farm's operating evidence for the claim period. Direction two — government.grant-programme-administration owns the funder-side programme lifecycle: scheme rules, application intake, eligibility assessment, award or refusal, payment authorisation, monitoring and recovery. The same claim packet may carry both structures, but a scheme name, grant reference, holding name or claim period alone discriminates neither; the farm row must not take an award notice without farm-production evidence, and the government row must not take a crop plan merely because it is attached to a claim.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: `Water-Abstraction-Permit_Farm-12.pdf`. Direction one — resource_operations.farm-records owns an operator-side farm record only when the permit is joined to field or storage use, abstraction measurements, irrigation activity, compliance return or a completed farm workflow. Direction two — government.permit-licensing owns the issuing-authority instrument: application, decision, conditions, effective area, variation, renewal, suspension or revocation. The authority name, permit number, farm address and condition schedule alone do not allocate custody; this row must not claim an issuer-side permit from a farmer's reference copy, and the government row must not claim field use from the instrument alone.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: `Nutrient-and-Runoff-Compliance-Return_Field-12.xlsx`. Direction one — resource_operations.farm-records owns the operator's field, crop, nutrient application, soil or runoff measurements and corrective work as part of running the holding. Direction two — government.environmental-regulation owns the authority-side return intake, permit-condition assessment, sampling or enforcement case. A parameter, unit, field name, permit reference or exceedance word alone supports neither direction; the farm row must not take an authority inspection or notice without operator-side production evidence, and the government row must not take a farmer's input log merely because it reports a regulated parameter.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: `Farm-Assurance-Inspection_Red-Hill_2026-06.pdf`. Direction one — resource_operations.farm-records owns the inspected holding's field, crop, livestock, treatment, traceability and corrective-operation evidence. Direction two — business_operations.compliance-audit owns the audit programme, control objective, assessor finding, nonconformity, remediation owner, evidence request and closure record. An audit checklist, certification body, farm name, finding or renewal date alone does not allocate the file; this row must not take a generic internal audit, and compliance-audit must not take a field register merely because an auditor reviewed it.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: `Irrigation-Pump-Commissioning-Pack_Field-12.zip`. Direction one — resource_operations.farm-records owns an operating farm relation only when the installed pump or irrigation asset is tied to completed field use, water application, production monitoring or an operating register. Direction two — engineering.commissioning-handover owns controlled design identity, inspection and test results, settings, as-built records, punch-list closure and acceptance of the installed system. A pump tag, field address, flow value, drawing or handover word alone does not allocate the bytes; this row must not take a design or commissioning pack merely because it names a farm, and engineering must not take a completed crop or irrigation log merely because it names the commissioned pump.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: `Farm-Solar-and-Crop-Operations_2026.xlsx`. Direction one — resource_operations.farm-records owns field, crop, livestock, input and harvest relations, including a farm's solar installation only where it is incidental to the holding's operation. Direction two — resource_operations.renewable-generation owns a generation installation, generator or export meter, production intervals, availability, curtailment, incentive and energy-settlement relation. A solar-farm name, energy quantity, export column, season or site name alone allocates neither direction; this row must not take generator performance merely because the installation sits on agricultural land, and renewable-generation must not take a crop or herd return merely because the workbook also records electricity.

falls_through_to.why: A standalone crop plan, herd register, treatment note, yield return or durable farm notice with no accepted holding, field, herd or seasonal group remains meaningful without forcing an unlicensed resource hierarchy.

A readable field map, quantity workbook, OCR scan or mixed operational record whose farm, engineering, government, finance or business role cannot be established from its own evidence is partly understood and should remain unresolved.

Farm records can expose named landholders, addresses, animal identifiers, veterinary medicines, chemical applications, subsidy status and commercially sensitive yields. When no deeper group is accepted, the protected residual preserves safety without creating a destination dimension.

An isolated portal receipt, delivery acknowledgement, inspection appointment or animal-movement confirmation without the underlying farm register or operating chain is a transaction or confirmation, not proof of this template.
A field, animal, crop or machinery photograph with no legible operating relation and no accepted farm group remains an unassociated image; EXIF, GPS and OCR cannot manufacture the farm fact.

An agronomy guide, subsidy guidance note, public market report, general animal-care article or regulator publication with no evidence of use in one holding's workflow is reference material rather than a farm record.
An encrypted portal export, proprietary farm-system database or unreadable scan is represented safely from metadata and cannot activate from a farm-shaped filename.

sensitivity_why: Farm records can join identifiable people and businesses to land parcels, farm addresses, animal or herd identifiers, veterinary medicines, chemical applications, production volumes, subsidy claims, assurance findings and commercial buyers. Those relations can reveal private land use, regulated treatment, animal health and business performance. Recognition should therefore use labelled structures and bounded excerpts; raw identifiers, coordinates, quantities, medicine details and claim references remain local and are not destination fields. This row assigns no handling class and does not infer protection policy beyond the catalogue's potentially_sensitive value.
open_question: NEEDS-JOSEPH NJ-FARM-1: should farm records remain a template on the broad resource_operations schema, or should R1c collapse crop, livestock, forestry and fisheries situations into a smaller neutral operating-source template once the schema fields are adjudicated? NJ-FARM-2: should the eventual canonical vocabulary reuse the anchor's proposed `site`, `asset`, `output_stream`, `reporting_period` and global `record_type`, or license a privacy-safe field/block or biological-unit role for farm records? This row proposes no private synonym. NJ-FARM-3: when one subsidy claim or assurance packet contains both operator production evidence and a government or business audit lifecycle, should R1c lift schema-level coactivation for resource_operations↔government and resource_operations↔business_operations, or require separate evidence records without a coactivation edge? Templates cannot author `also_holds_with`. NJ-FARM-4: should animal identifiers, veterinary details, land coordinates and subsidy references remain search-only even after fields are licensed, or may a user-confirmed private tree expose selected values? NJ-FARM-5: can a farm image or GIS boundary be admitted to a farm group only through an exact holding/field anchor, or should user-accepted field context be sufficient when the image itself has no readable label?
